title: Huntik Foundation's cabin cruiser
summary: A cabin cruiser is a large motor yacht used by Huntik Foundation operatives for long journeys in open water. These boats are much bigger than the Speedboat models and feature a built-in GPS that links directly to a Seeker's Holotome.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Huntik team travelled in a Foundation Cabin Cruiser to travel across the Aegean Sea on their mission to find the Argo. On their journey, they began to relax and enjoyed water-skiing. However the boat's engine was badly damaged by an obscure and toxic plant life, forcing them to take a detour to Madea Island whilst they made repairs. [The Beautiful Trap] After repairing the boat, the team travelled on to Sutos, narrowly avoiding being crushed by two moving cliffs. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Dante used the Foundation boat to travel to the Sea of Cortés in the midst of dangerous storm whilst searching for Hernán Cortés' vault. [Gremlow Infestation!]
